company.name: WINPAC Trading Company
company.tagline: Have a surface problem? Let's solve it.
company.intro: Abrasives, machines, stone care chemicals and natural stone aggregates for granite and marble factories, flooring contractors and restorers across Sri Lanka.
company.motto: We solve a problem, not just sell a product.
company.about: WINPAC Trading Company was started by K. Balasubramaniam in 1988 as a supplier of terrazzo materials. Today we are the official distributor for manufacturers around the world, supplying solutions for terrazzo, cement, concrete, natural stone and engineered surfaces. As the largest market share holder in our industry, we take equal pride and responsibility in every product we sell.
company.vision: To continuously be the most trusted provider of solutions to problems and requirements of any scale, for any and all surfaces in Sri Lanka.
company.mission: To understand the requirements of our customers and provide the right solution, through our partners or by manufacturing it ourselves.
company.hours: Monday to Saturday, 8.30 am to 5.30 pm
company.chemText: Where the right product doesn't exist off the shelf, we develop one for your surface. Since 2018 we have provided customised chemical solutions that save contractors time and money.

chemItems.label: Concrete reactive stains

chemItems.label: Repair & restoration
chemItems.value: Restore damaged and worn surfaces instead of replacing them.
